title: Owner must assign report units
body: Do not infer units from count alone. Preserve the preliminary v1 report. The final contract will assign pieces explicitly in v2 through the stopped-worker material input gate.
requested_response: Preserve v1, record this reply as reported reading and finish initial handoff; stop the units exchange until exact v2 input is bound.
limitations: Owner response is a bounded fixture decision; discussion does not rebind inputs.
